why: letters with accents keep their accents
the dotted capital I becomes a plain i (toLowerCase of JavaScript adds a dot above)
each capital sigma becomes σ, also at the end of a word (toLowerCase of JavaScript gives ς there)
the sharp s stays one letter (casefold of Python gives ss)
Arabic yeh, kaf and alef maksura become the Persian letters
teh marbuta and heh with yeh become heh
Persian and Arabic-Indic digits become ASCII digits
the zero-width non-joiner becomes a space
the last letter of each of the first three ranges of the table
a letter outside the first plane of Unicode
a text with no capitals stays as it is
